title: Near-Infrared Luminescent Ln3 Clusters and a One-Dimensional Yb3 Coordination Polymer with a Benzimidazole Ligand

synthesis.procedure: Under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen (Schlenk), a solution of LnCl3·6H2O (0.03 mmol) in EtOH (5 mL) was added to a solution of HL (0.013 g, 0.04 mmol) in EtOH (5 mL). The mixture was stirred and heated under reflux for 2 h, cooled to room temperature, and filtered. Diethyl ether was allowed to diffuse slowly into the filtrate at room temperature, giving yellow crystalline 1a after 1 month, isolated by filtration.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques under dry N2; reflux then diethyl-ether vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled, filtered; Et2O vapor diffusion into the filtrate at room temperature; yellow crystals isolated by filtration

properties.summary: Upon ligand-centered excitation, 1a shows typical Tb3+ visible emission (5D4 → 7Fj) in CH3CN and a similar luminescence in the solid state. Fluorescence quantum yield Φem = 0.218 in CH3CN (quinine sulfate standard).

measurements.name: fluorescence quantum yield (Φem)
measurements.conditions: 1a in CH3CN at 298 K; quinine sulfate Φem = 0.546 in 0.5 M H2SO4 as standard

measurements.name: Tb3+ visible emission (5D4 → 7Fj, j = 1–4)
measurements.conditions: CH3CN, 5 × 10^-6 M, 298 K (Figure 8); similar emission in the solid state

properties.summary: Upon ligand-centered excitation, 1b shows Er3+ NIR emission assigned to 4I13/2 → 4I15/2 at 1510 nm in CH3CN; similar luminescence in the solid state. NIR quantum yield could not be measured due to instrumental limitations.

measurements.conditions: CH3CN, 5 × 10^-6 M, 298 K (Figure 9); similar emission in the solid state

properties.summary: Upon ligand-centered excitation, 1c shows Yb3+ NIR emission assigned to 2F5/2 → 2F7/2 at about 978 nm in CH3CN and similar luminescence in the solid state. Relative emission intensity at 978 nm versus polymer 2 is lower (2:1c ≈ 3.6 at equal absorbance at 275 nm), attributed to coordinated H2O quenching in 1c.

measurements.name: Yb3+ NIR emission (2F5/2 → 2F7/2)
measurements.conditions: CH3CN, 298 K; similar emission in the solid state

measurements.name: relative NIR emission intensity at 978 nm (2:1c)
measurements.conditions: CH3CN, 298 K, same absorbance at 275 nm

material_class.structural_family: Yb3L4 clusters linked by double acetate bridges into a 1-D coordination polymer

synthesis.procedure: Under dry N2, a solution of YbCl3·6H2O (0.012 g, 0.03 mmol) in EtOH (5 mL) was added to HL (0.013 g, 0.04 mmol) in EtOH (5 mL) and refluxed 2 h. After cooling to room temperature, Zn(OAc)2·2H2O (0.110 g, 0.50 mmol) in EtOH (5 mL) was added and the mixture was refluxed 1 h, cooled, and filtered. Slow Et2O diffusion into the filtrate gave pale yellow single crystals of 2 after two weeks.
synthesis.time: reflux 2 h then additional reflux 1 h after Zn(OAc)2 addition; crystallization 2 weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques under dry N2; sequential reflux then diethyl-ether vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled, filtered; Et2O vapor diffusion; pale yellow crystals after two weeks

properties.summary: Upon ligand-centered excitation, 2 shows Yb3+ NIR emission (2F5/2 → 2F7/2) at about 978 nm in CH3CN and similar solid-state luminescence. Relative emission intensity at 978 nm is 3.6 times that of 1c under equal absorbance at 275 nm, attributed to the absence of coordinated H2O.

measurements.name: Yb3+ NIR emission (2F5/2 → 2F7/2)
measurements.conditions: CH3CN, 2 × 10^-6 M, 298 K (Figure 9); similar emission in the solid state

measurements.conditions: CH3CN, 298 K, same absorbance at 275 nm
